emma_cs: FYI APAC onboarding jobs saw intermittent 502s for some tenants 03:12-03:40 UTC. Need short customer status + office hours plan.

marta_eng: Root cause = reconnect flood in assignment-service under parallel imports. Fix in staging.

julian_support: Please share CSV of affected tenants. CS needs to start outreach.

leo_csm: High-touch get personal email + office hours invite; self-serve get status + feedback form.

sophie_ops: Proposed APAC office hours 2024-07-19 04:00 UTC (12:00 JST). 1h slot, capacity 8.

emma_cs: Draft status note ready (short):
[message template sent externally summarizing timeline, impact, fix, office hours link, recovery credit offer].

ana_legal: Quick legal: avoid SLA admission; credit as gesture of goodwill. Approve with minor wording edits.

deploy_bot: canary deploy started assignment-service:build-20240719-11

marta_eng: Canary OK at 03:58 UTC; rolling to APAC.

julian_support: CSV uploaded: https://redwood.internal/attachments/impacted_onboards_1784203344.csv

leo_csm: Proposed recovery: one-time 10% onboarding credit + optional 60-min enablement session. Legal ok.

raj_pm: Metrics for comms: estimate auto-recovered vs manual re-run?

marta_eng: Final: 79% auto-recovered, 21% manual re-run. Technical summary: connection backoff + queue-drain fix.

emma_cs: Action items: leo send high-touch emails by 04:30 UTC; julian create tickets for manual re-runs; marta paste final tech summary by 05:00 UTC; ana sign off by 04:15 UTC; sophie publish office hours link.

sophie_ops: Office hours link published: https://meet.redwood/apac-office-hours-20240719 (8 slots).

leo_csm: Sent first batch to top accounts; flagged 4 renewal accounts in CRM and pinged AEs.

marta_eng: Postmortem ETA 2024-07-22 COB.

emma_cs: After office hours collect 2-question satisfaction + feedback. Closing thread unless escalations. :white_check_mark:
